description: Subte: Trenes despachados is a dataset listed in City of Buenos Aires open data portal (BA Data), an open data portal, published or maintained by Subterráneos de Buenos Aires (SBASE). Información de las formaciones despachadas en todas las líneas del Subte. Coverage: Ciudad de Buenos Aires. The portal files it under the publisher Subterráneos de Buenos Aires (SBASE). Its tags are subte, transporte, tránsito. It offers 15 resource(s) in CSV, XLSX. The portal shows 2026-08-28 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-2.5-AR. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support rail network and station studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-caba-portal.
